notes: Sync: discovering pairs now shows a progress bar with status (an indeterminate sweep while searching Jira, then a count as each pair is resolved). Sync: applying a master no longer re-runs the whole discovery. Only the pair(s) you just synced are refreshed in place; everything else — and your selection — stays put. Sync status mapping: a Jira issue in 'Testing' now counts as in agreement with a Closed/Resolved FogBugz case (testing = closed). Jira 'Done' now also matches the resolved-then-closed FogBugz states like 'Closed (Implemented)' and 'Closed (Fixed)', not just the 'Resolved (…)' ones. Sync assignee mapping: FogBugz cases owned by the TMM team no longer show a false assignee conflict against the shared TMM Jira account (noreply@trumpf.com). Configurable via [assignee] tmm_jira_email.
